summary.text: Vaughn McLaughlin is the Democratic candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
McLaughlin was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: McLaughlin advanced unopposed from the 2024 Democratic primary for Senate District 1 with 1,311 votes.
In the November 5, 2024 general election McLaughlin lost to Republican Susan Y. Bernard, 6,892 votes (34.2 percent) to 13,248 (65.8 percent).
In 2026 McLaughlin advanced unopposed from the June 9 Democratic primary with 2,995 votes.
